rows.title: Payroll into the bonus account only
rows.defect: deposits into any account count toward the bonus
rows.test: a $3,250 paycheck into checking is not the bonus deposit

rows.title: Coffee is a purchase, not a fee
rows.defect: "fee" is matched inside COFFEE (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: two coffee purchases count toward the debits

rows.title: A transfer is not a purchase
rows.defect: transfers count as debit purchases
rows.test: a $50 transfer to savings does not count

rows.title: Late deposits do not meet the requirement
rows.defect: rows after the deadline count (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: a deposit five days after the deadline leaves the bonus missed

rows.title: The deadline day counts
rows.defect: the deadline day itself is left out
rows.test: a deposit on the deadline day meets it

rows.title: Due today is not missed
rows.defect: a requirement due today reads as missed
rows.test: a requirement due today is still in progress

rows.title: The bonus is its own amount
rows.defect: any bonus-worded credit marks it paid
rows.test: a $25 promotional credit is not the $300 bonus

rows.title: Overdue only after the payout date
rows.defect: the payout date itself reads as overdue
rows.test: on the payout date it is still awaited

rows.title: Days, not readings
rows.defect: every balance reading counts as a day (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: two balances on Oct 1 are one day

rows.title: No history is unknown
rows.defect: no history reads as not met instead of unknown
rows.test: no balance history is never "in progress"

rows.title: Thirty days before the early-closure window ends
rows.defect: the reminder is a day early
rows.test: the reminder is Feb 18 for Mar 20

rows.title: A year is said once
rows.defect: the yearly figure and twelve months of it are added (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: the match gap's reason says $1,350.00 a year

rows.title: An expired stipend is gone
rows.defect: the expiry is not checked (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: the Learning stipend that expired Sep 30 is not offered

rows.title: The last day to claim still counts
rows.defect: a stipend expiring today is dropped
rows.test: a stipend expiring today is offered

rows.title: Merchant and state, both
rows.defect: the state check is dropped
rows.test: a CA resident does not match a TX-only settlement

rows.title: The last claim day is open
rows.defect: the claim deadline day is treated as closed
rows.test: a settlement closing today still matches

rows.title: A closed recall window is not money
rows.defect: the recall's deadline is not checked (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: a recall whose refund deadline was Oct 1 is not offered

rows.title: Expired points are worth nothing
rows.defect: expired points are valued (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: points that expired Oct 1 are not valued

rows.title: The real rate, not the advertised one
rows.defect: the advertised rate is the expected value

rows.title: The transfer is worth the difference
rows.defect: the whole transfer value is the expected gain
rows.test: Mock Air is worth $108.00 more than cash

rows.title: One credit, one referral
rows.defect: a used credit can pay a second referral (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: one $50.00 credit is one payout seen

rows.title: The cash-out fee comes off
rows.defect: the cash-out fee is ignored in the hourly rate
rows.test: Mock Surveys is $4.00 an hour

rows.title: The deadline day alerts
rows.defect: the day itself stays quiet
rows.test: a deadline today fires

rows.title: Seven days out, not six
rows.defect: the week-out alert fires a day late
rows.test: Oct 19 fires on Oct 12, Oct 18 does not

rows.title: The bonus credit lands in the bonus account
rows.defect: the account is not checked (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: another bank's $300 bonus does not verify this one

rows.title: An election is not dollars
rows.defect: the year's match is booked as verified on the election (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: a raised election books $0.00

rows.title: One credit is booked once
rows.defect: a credit is booked again on each new day (the bug found building this packet)
rows.test: the same $300.00 verified on three days is one entry

rows.title: Verified credits only
rows.defect: any result object is booked
rows.test: an unverified result is refused

rows.title: Verified money first
rows.defect: verified plays rank by their dollars only
rows.test: the verified $1.00 tops the queue

rows.title: Time divides the dollars
rows.defect: time cost is ignored
rows.test: $8.00 for four hours sinks below $5.00 for one

rows.title: Today is required
rows.defect: today is not validated
rows.test: a missing or US-format today throws
